name: @acyclic-labs/fs
description: Versioned workspaces for browser, memory, hosted, and native providers

scripts.build:proto: cd ../../.. && bun x buf format --diff --exit-code --path proto/filesystem/v2 && bun x buf lint && bun run generate
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:clean: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml -p acyclic-fs-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm-release --locked && wasm-bindgen ../../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-release/acyclic_fs_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir generated/wasm --out-name acyclic_fs_wasm
scripts.test: bun run test:composition && bun run test:s3
scripts.pack:dry: bun run build:clean && bun pm pack --dry-run
